nodes.description: IERC20 atari token used for buying tickets and paying rewards in Lottery.
LotteryNFT contract reference that mints and tracks lottery tickets.
Admin address checked by the onlyAdmin modifier.
Minimum ticket price required by buy()/multiBuy().
Carried-over balance from the previous game, re-invested as a null ticket in reset().
Current lottery issue/round index used to key history and user data.
Total amount collected in the current issue, used as pool size.
Count of distinct participating addresses, mixed into the randomness seed.
Timestamp of the last buy/reset, used to schedule the next draw.
Timestamp after which drawing() may be executed.
Timestamp after which enterDrawingPhase() may be executed.
Flag enabling/disabling the drawing phase and blocking buys.
Winning numbers for the current issue written by drawing().
Per-issue record of total and per-tier reward amounts.
Per-issue/per-combination aggregated buy amounts used in reward math.
Mapping of user address to owned ticket ids.
Per-issue recorded draw timestamp.
LotteryNFT mapping recording whether a ticket reward was claimed.
LotteryNFT mapping storing the paid amount per ticket id.
LotteryNFT mapping storing the issue index per ticket id.
Owner/admin address stored in LotteryOwnable and checked by onlyOwner.
Initializable.initialize() that wires token/NFT/admin, sets timers and ownership.
reset() admin function clearing issue state, bumping issueIndex and re-buying remainBalance.
enterDrawingPhase() gated by block.timestamp/owner that flips drawingPhase on.
drawing() computes pseudo-random winning numbers from blockhash/gas/external input and settles rewards.
internalBuy() mints a ticket to the contract itself (used for carried-over balance).
buy() external entry minting a ticket, updating totals and pulling atari from the buyer.
multiBuy() external batch version of buy() pulling the aggregated price.
claimReward() external entry paying a single ticket reward to its owner.
multiClaim() external entry paying aggregated rewards for a list of tickets.
generateNumberIndexKey() pure helper encoding 4 numbers into 11 combination keys.
calculateMatchingRewardAmount() derives tier pools from userBuyAmountSum.
getRewardView() view computing the reward owed for a ticket.
getTotalRewards() view returning the reward pool for an issue.
setAdmin() onlyOwner setter for the admin address.
adminWithdraw() onlyAdmin emergency drain of atari to the caller.
adminWithdrawSafe() onlyAdmin drain limited to balance minus reward pool.
LotteryNFT.newLotteryItem() onlyOwner mint storing lottery numbers/amount/issue.
LotteryNFT.claimReward() onlyOwner marking a ticket as claimed.
LotteryNFT.multiClaimReward() onlyOwner batch marking tickets claimed.
LotteryNFT.burn() onlyOwner burning a ticket via ERC721._burn.
ERC721._checkOnERC721Received() low-level call into the receiver contract.
multicall.setPath() unrestricted setter replacing the referenced Lottery and LotteryNFT.
multicall.ticketDatas() view aggregating ticket reward/claim/draw data.
multicall.historyDatas() view aggregating per-issue history data.
msg.sender, attacker-controlled caller identity.
block.timestamp, miner-influenceable time source used for scheduling.
atari.safeTransferFrom(msg.sender, this, _price) inside buy().
atari.safeTransferFrom(msg.sender, this, totalPrice) inside multiBuy().
atari.safeTransfer(msg.sender, reward) inside claimReward().
atari.safeTransfer(msg.sender, totalReward) inside multiClaim().
atari.safeTransfer(msg.sender, _amount) inside adminWithdraw().
atari.safeTransfer(msg.sender, _amount) inside adminWithdrawSafe().
Low-level Address.functionCall invoking onERC721Received on an arbitrary contract.
Weak pseudo-randomness built from blockhash(block.number-1), totalAmount, gasleft and caller input.
_price parameter of buy()/multiBuy() validated against minPrice and transferred.
_numbers parameter of buy() bounded by maxNumber and stored in the ticket.
_tokenId parameter of claimReward() checked against NFT ownership.
reward local variable in claimReward() holding the computed payout.
_amount parameter of adminWithdraw() forwarded to the token transfer.
_externalRandomNumber parameter of drawing() mixed into the seed.
_randomNumber local in drawing() derived from keccak256/blockhash entropy.

edges.reason: msg.sender identifies the ticket buyer in buy().
msg.sender must equal lotteryNFT.ownerOf(_tokenId) in claimReward().
msg.sender is verified as ticket owner in multiClaim().
adminWithdraw() requires msg.sender == adminAddress and pays msg.sender.
adminWithdrawSafe() requires msg.sender == adminAddress and pays msg.sender.
reset() is guarded by onlyAdmin comparing msg.sender to adminAddress.
enterDrawingPhase() grants the owner path via msg.sender==owner().
drawing() grants the owner path via msg.sender==owner().
drawing() gate depends on block.timestamp >= nextDraw.
enterDrawingPhase() gate depends on block.timestamp >= nextPharse.
reset() re-anchors the schedule with lastTimestamp = block.timestamp.
buy() refreshes lastTimestamp = block.timestamp, shifting the draw schedule.
block.timestamp is written into the lastTimestamp state variable.
_price is compared to minPrice and used for totalAmount in buy().
_numbers are bounded by maxNumber and stored in the ticket in buy().
_tokenId drives the ownership check and reward computation in claimReward().
computed reward local is the amount transferred in claimReward().
_amount is forwarded to atari.safeTransfer in adminWithdraw().
caller-supplied _externalRandomNumber is mixed into the keccak256 seed.
_randomNumber is derived from weak blockhash-based entropy.
_price is the value moved by safeTransferFrom in buy().
buy() executes atari.safeTransferFrom near the end of the function.
multiBuy() executes atari.safeTransferFrom for totalPrice.
claimReward() executes atari.safeTransfer for the reward.
multiClaim() executes atari.safeTransfer for totalReward.
adminWithdraw() executes atari.safeTransfer for _amount.
adminWithdrawSafe() executes atari.safeTransfer for the residual balance.
_checkOnERC721Received performs a low-level call to onERC721Received.
drawing() seeds the winning numbers from blockhash and assembly modulo.
a malicious ERC20 implementation can re-enter buy() through the token callback.
a malicious ERC20 implementation can re-enter multiBuy() during safeTransferFrom.
a malicious ERC20 implementation can re-enter claimReward() during safeTransfer.
a malicious ERC20 implementation can re-enter multiClaim() during safeTransfer.
an attacker receiver contract can re-enter during onERC721Received.
buy() mints a ticket through lotteryNFT.newLotteryItem().
internalBuy() mints a self-owned ticket through lotteryNFT.newLotteryItem().
claimReward() marks the ticket claimed via lotteryNFT.claimReward().
multiClaim() batch-marks tickets via the NFT claim helper.
drawing() calls calculateMatchingRewardAmount() to fill historyAmount.
calculateMatchingRewardAmount() derives index keys via generateNumberIndexKey().
getRewardView() reads the pool size from getTotalRewards().
getTotalRewards() returns historyAmount[_issueIndex][0].
claimReward() computes the payout with getRewardView().
issueIndex keys historyNumbers/historyAmount/drawTimes in drawing().
totalAmount is mixed into the randomness seed and reward math in drawing().
totalAddresses is mixed into the randomness seed in drawing().
remainBalance is re-invested as a null ticket inside reset().
drawing() reads lastTimestamp to build the third winning number.
drawing() writes the unmatched remainder into remainBalance.
multicall.historyDatas() reads lottery.issueIndex() to bound issue lookups.
historyDatas() is a public view readable by any msg.sender.
buy() requires drawingPhase to be false before selling tickets.
buy()/internalBuy() abort when drawed() (winningNumbers[0]!=0).
minPrice bounds the accepted _price in buy()/multiBuy().

normalization_plan.reason: _price is only meaningful inside buy(); fold the parameter into the buy() function node.
_numbers is only meaningful inside buy(); fold the parameter into the buy() function node.
_tokenId is consumed only by claimReward(); fold into the claimReward() function node.
the reward local is created and spent inside claimReward(); fold into the claimReward() function node.
_amount is only meaningful inside adminWithdraw(); fold into the adminWithdraw() function node.
_externalRandomNumber is only consumed by drawing(); fold into the drawing() function node.
_randomNumber directly feeds the weak-randomness unsafe operation; fold into that unsafe node.
